mandatory_mechanism_challenges.distinction: Realized volatility aggregates the magnitude of close-to-close returns. Campaign017 forbids close and measures the signed co-movement of range-center changes with range-width changes.

mandatory_mechanism_challenges.name: intraday_volatility_resolution_238m
mandatory_mechanism_challenges.distinction: Volatility resolution compares morning and afternoon squared close-return allocation. Campaign017 forms a local signed high-low leverage statistic on every within-half adjacent transition.

mandatory_mechanism_challenges.name: intraday_return_skewness_238m
mandatory_mechanism_challenges.distinction: Return skewness is the third standardized moment of close returns. Campaign017 reads no close, computes no return moment, and uses the joint change of high-low center and width.

mandatory_mechanism_challenges.name: intraday_intrabar_body_range_efficiency_240m
mandatory_mechanism_challenges.distinction: Campaign009 divides absolute same-bar open-close body length by high-low range. Campaign017 forbids open and close and correlates adjacent geometric-center changes with adjacent width changes.

mandatory_mechanism_challenges.name: intraday_adjacent_range_overlap_continuity_238p
mandatory_mechanism_challenges.distinction: Campaign010 measures intersection relative to union between adjacent price intervals. Campaign017 computes neither overlap nor containment; identical interval widths can yield different values when center and width changes co-move differently.

mandatory_mechanism_challenges.name: intraday_intrabar_range_participation_entropy_240m
mandatory_mechanism_challenges.distinction: Campaign011 is the order-insensitive entropy of the 240 range-width shares. Campaign017 is order-sensitive, retains signed center motion, and uses correlation rather than a dispersion functional.

mandatory_mechanism_challenges.name: intraday_intrabar_range_reversal_238p
mandatory_mechanism_challenges.distinction: Campaign012 correlates successive range-width levels and negates the result. Campaign017 correlates the first difference of geometric center with the first difference of width; it is not range autocorrelation.

mandatory_mechanism_challenges.name: intraday_global_price_range_revisit_240m
mandatory_mechanism_challenges.distinction: Campaign014 is invariant to bar order and measures global interval union reuse. Campaign017 depends on adjacent ordering and discards global union topology.

mandatory_mechanism_challenges.name: intraday_prior_range_breakout_pressure_238p
mandatory_mechanism_challenges.distinction: Campaign015 locates the current close beyond the previous high-low boundary. Campaign017 forbids close and never tests a breakout or prior-boundary exceedance.

mandatory_mechanism_challenges.name: intraday_interbar_gap_body_confirmation_238p
mandatory_mechanism_challenges.distinction: Campaign016 correlates previous-close-to-current-open gaps with current open-to-close bodies. Campaign017 forbids open and close and instead measures directional range-center motion versus range-width expansion.

mandatory_mechanism_challenges.name: intraday_cumulative_vwap_crossing_rate_240m
mandatory_mechanism_challenges.distinction: Candidate49 counts close crossings around causal cumulative VWAP. Campaign017 has no close, amount, volume, cumulative state, crossing count, or Candidate49 historical return read.

candidate.name: intraday_midrange_width_change_coupling_238p
candidate.economic_hypothesis: Positive coupling between signed geometric range-center changes and high-low width changes indicates that volatility expands during upward rather than downward price discovery, which may persist over the next three sessions.
candidate.formula: population Pearson correlation Corr(delta_m_t,delta_w_t), where m_i=(log(high_i)+log(low_i))/2 and w_i=log(high_i/low_i), across exactly 238 within-half adjacent transitions
formula_steps: Require the exact accepted 241-row source grid, preserve but exclude standalone 09:30, and select exactly the 240 bars at 09:31-11:30 and 13:01-15:00.
Require every selected high and low to be finite and strictly positive with exact raw ordering low_i <= high_i. Do not round, clamp, sort, repair, or use a price-grid tolerance.
For each selected bar compute the log geometric range center m_i=(log(high_i)+log(low_i))/2 and log range width w_i=log(high_i/low_i). A zero-width interval has w_i=0 and remains valid.

Inside each 120-bar trading half only, form 119 transitions from previous bar i to current bar t=i+1. Morning and afternoon contribute exactly 238 transitions. Form no 09:30, lunch, overnight, cross-day, cross-stock, or higher-lag transition.
For each transition compute delta_m_t=m_t-m_i and delta_w_t=w_t-w_i. Exact zero center or width changes and every sign combination remain in the fixed 238-pair support.

Compute population means, centered sums Smm=sum((delta_m-mean(delta_m))^2), Sww=sum((delta_w-mean(delta_w))^2), and Smw=sum((delta_m-mean(delta_m))*(delta_w-mean(delta_w))). Require every component finite and Smm and Sww strictly positive. No nonzero-count, positive-range-count, magnitude, volatility, or activity threshold is allowed.

Compute q=Smw/sqrt(Smm*Sww). If q lies within 1e-12 beyond either mathematical endpoint, canonicalize it to that endpoint; otherwise require q finite and within [-1,1]. Return q without clipping inside the range, winsorization, smoothing, ranking, sign conversion, or another normalization.
candidate.timestamp_semantics: Use exactly 238 adjacent high-low center/width transitions: 119 inside the morning half and 119 inside the afternoon half. Exclude 09:30 and the lunch transition.
candidate.zero_missing_denominator_semantics: All exact-zero widths, center changes, and width changes remain in fixed support. A stock-day is missing only for invalid/nonpositive/nonfinite high-low input, low>high ordering, nonfinite transformed/component values, zero population variance in either 238-vector, or a correlation outside the endpoint tolerance.
mechanism_distinction_before_values: Holding every high-low width fixed while changing interval centers can change Campaign017 but leaves range entropy and range reversal width sequences unchanged.
Holding every interval center fixed while changing the ordered width path can change Campaign017 but leaves close/open/gap/body, transaction-price, amount, and volume mechanisms unavailable.

An upward center change accompanied by width expansion contributes positive covariance; downward expansion or upward contraction contributes negative covariance; zero changes stay explicit observations.
Campaign017 contains no open, close, body, wick split, prior-boundary breakout, interval-overlap ratio, global union, amount, volume, transaction price, VWAP, market peer, or forward return.
